Terra claimed officer on day 1 and said Luna was a killer, and Palermo voted Luna out that day. Luna's last words named Sol, and on day 2 Opus claimed to be the doctor and said he had blocked a kill on Terra. Day 3 went wrong when Sonnet questioned Opus's saves, and the town voted Sonnet out as a citizen. On night 4 Haiku was killed, and on day 4 Sol turned on Opus, then was voted out as the last killer. The town won.
